name: FARO
tagline: FARO scanners and software capture a physical scene as a 3D point cloud, which forensic engineers then turn into measured diagrams and animations of how an accident or structural failure happened. AI-assisted processing cleans up and registers scans automatically, cutting down the manual work needed to turn a raw scan into a court-ready reconstruction.
